name: Roasted Lamb
description: A slow-roasted lamb recipe with a flavorful garlic and rosemary paste, perfect for a tender and aromatic main course.

recipeInstructions.text: Make a paste with olive oil, butter, garlic, and rosemary.
Make small holes in the lamb and insert garlic cloves or pieces.
Smear the lamb with the prepared paste.
Sprinkle with flour and place in a roasting pan.
Add a scant amount of water to the pan and sprinkle rosemary on top.
Roast slowly at 250°F to 300°F for 6 to 7 hours or until done.
Remove the lid near the end to brown the lamb.

keywords: roasted lamb, garlic and rosemary, slow cooking

_similar.description: A creamy mushroom soup made with sautéed mushrooms, onions, and garlic in a rich milk-based broth.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute butter, onion, garlic and mushrooms.
Add flour and stir together.
Add stock, sauces and milk.
Simmer until heated through (approximately 15 minutes).
Serve hot.

_similar.name: Barley and Corn Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty barley casserole with corn, carrots, and garlic, perfect as a comforting side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy casserole. Cook onion, garlic, and carrots until the onion is softened, stirring frequently.
Stir in barley and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, cover, and bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.
Test that barley is tender. Stir in corn and parsley.
Return to the oven to heat through. Season with pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: barley casserole, corn, carrots, comforting side dish

_similar.name: Pasta & Bean Soup
_similar.description: A hearty and flavorful soup featuring pasta, beans, and vegetables in a tomato-based broth.
recipeIngredient: 19 oz can white kidney or romano beans, drained
10 oz can chicken broth, diluted with 1 cup water
3 cups small shell pasta or macaroni

recipeInstructions.text: Place oil in a large pan over medium heat. Stir in onion, carrots, celery, and garlic. Cook, uncovered, stirring often, until onion is soft, about 5 minutes.
Add broth, tomatoes and juice, seasoning, and beans. Break up tomatoes. Increase heat to medium and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Uncover, increase heat, and bring to a boil. Add pasta or macaroni. Boil gently, uncovered, stirring often, for about 8 minutes.
If desired, add additional hot broth or water for more broth. Stir in basil and Parmesan. Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: pasta soup, bean soup, Italian soup, vegetable broth

_similar.name: Pizza Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty pizza casserole made with spaghetti, hamburger, pepperoni, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp cooking oil or olive oil

recipeInstructions.text: Cook spaghetti as per package instructions and drain.
In a bowl, combine cooked spaghetti, margarine or butter, eggs, and Parmesan cheese.
Spread the spaghetti mixture in a greased 9x13 inch pan.
Brown hamburger and onion in a skillet and spoon over the spaghetti mixture.
Spread spaghetti sauce over the hamburger mixture and cover with mozzarella cheese.
Sprinkle with oregano and drizzle with oil.
Arrange pepperoni slices on top.
Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes.

_similar.name: Chicken Glazed with Basil & Balsamic Vinegar
_similar.description: A glazed chicken breast recipe with basil, balsamic vinegar, and honey.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Place chicken breasts in a shallow baking dish.
In a saucepan, bring remaining ingredients to a boil.
Remove from heat and pour over chicken.
Bake for 20-30 minutes or until chicken is cooked, basting occasionally with the glaze.
Serve warm or cold.
